BiblicalUsage: Zererath is another spelling of Zeredah, the Ephraimite town where Jeroboam came from. In Judges 7:22, the host fled to Beth-shittah in Zererath.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Zererath reminds me Scripture happened somewhere, not in the abstract.
